Temple Attendant

You have swept the steps and held the hands of people whose prayers had no words left.

What promise outlasted your service?

Rules

Choose one:

- Radiance 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.ae631c154411e4e0.JournalEntryPage.f4aff541dead2b16]{Oathlight Strike}. - Life 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.85442bfefbe9d679.JournalEntryPage.3a15668fd31a6c80]{Shared Breath}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
